sources.title: Nanbeige4.3-33B: Open 33B Agent Model, 80.9 on Terminal-Bench ...
sources.snippet: Nanbeige4.3-33B is a new open-weight dense model released on October 24, 2026 under the Apache 2.0 license, built for coding and office-style agents. The model card on Hugging Face reports that it leads three comparable 30B-class models on most agentic benchmarks, including 80.9 on Terminal-Bench 2.1.

sources.snippet: Nanbeige released Nanbeige4.3-33B, an Apache 2.0 open-weight model it says leads most agentic coding tests in the 30B class.

sources.title: Nanbeige's New 33B Open Model Takes Aim at Qwen and Gemma on ...
sources.snippet: Nanbeige, the AI team backed by Chinese recruitment giant BOSS Zhipin, released Nanbeige4.3-33B on Hugging Face this week under an Apache 2.0 licence. The benchmark table attached to the model card makes a specific claim: at the 33 billion parameter scale, it beats Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B on seven of eight agentic-coding evaluations.
